analysis.definition: per dataset and variant arm, borda minus the variant arm accuracy, the fitting seeds averaged within each outer fold (one seed here, so the fold value is that seed's)
analysis.descriptive: per arm and dataset: accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1 and the neighbourhood purity of the last hidden ranking (outer-fold mean and SD); the depth probe at each hidden layer; the movement rates; no p value and no adjustment for these

inertness.definition: an arm is effectively inert on a fold when its changed-filter share over the hidden layers is below 0.01; the analysis reports the share of folds on which each arm is effectively inert and states that a contrast against an effectively inert arm is evidence about movement, not about the aggregation rule
inertness.status: read before any contrast of this family

analysis.interpretation: if the median matches Borda once the vote mass is matched, the paper says the aggregation choice is not the source of the learning effect
analysis.interval: corrected resampled t over the 15 outer folds (evaluation.paired_corrected_interval, q = 0.25, 95 per cent, 14 degrees of freedom)
analysis.limits: a controlled comparison at one configuration per fold, at one fitting seed, with the learning rate and the iteration count not re-tuned; it cannot estimate the best attainable model of any arm, and it cannot separate an arm that does not move from an arm that moves and does not help unless the movement rates are read with it
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across the seventeen datasets within each variant arm (evaluation.holm_adjust); the arms are adjusted separately and no adjustment crosses the two families
analysis.status: prespecified before any outer score of this family exists; computed only by the analyse stage, which refuses (exit 2, nothing written) until the run is complete, then re-verifies every job record, re-derives every sealed selection from its reference run and re-renders every table before any score is read

arm_definitions.borda: the unmodified update: the hidden-layer order is the accumulator row mean with ties by ascending item ID, the weighted Borda count of the votes and the prior
arm_definitions.median: the same votes, the same weights and the same prior weight 1, ordered by the exact footrule median (the linear assignment on C = A D) instead of the row mean
arm_definitions.median_mass_matched: the footrule median with the prior entered as m ballots of the mean incoming weight, m chosen on the training-only pilot so that the movement rate is comparable to borda's
arm_definitions.note: the three arms share the fold's selection, encoder, view identities, initial seeds, data, randomization, eligibility gate, batch resets, checkpoint and readout rule; the output layer keeps the core rule in every arm

checks.arm_parameters: every job: the fitted parameters equal the planned ones
checks.depth_probe_matches_readout: every job: the last depth probe equals the view readout
checks.frozen_layers_unchanged: every job: a frozen hidden layer's filters equal their initial ones and its recorded movement is exactly zero
checks.instrumentation_removed: every job: no vertex of any reachable graph keeps an instance-level wrapper
checks.reference_predictions: every job: the own arm's seven-view predictions on the outer test rows equal the reference run's recorded predictions for seed 8129 exactly, in the sealed order
checks.rng_untouched: every job: every guarded read left the global numpy and Python RNG states unchanged
checks.uninstrumented_state_hash: first outer fold of every dataset: the own arm's view state hashes and predictions equal MultiViewArrowFlowKNN(**selected, seed=8129).fit's on the same rows

dataset_loading: the reference run prepared data (hash-checked) must equal the ablation copy, its splits the declared nested splits, and in production a fresh load by the reference loader must return the same arrays and dataset hash
decision_rule: freeze only if the calibrated projection at 16 single-thread workers is at most 4.0 h: the simulated first-free-worker makespan of the planned jobs in planned order, each job priced at the reference run's realized outer fit and predict seconds of its fold and seed 8129 times the piloted job / uninstrumented-fit ratio (its own ratio for a pilot dataset, the largest piloted ratio otherwise), plus the realized seconds once more for the uninstrumented fit of a first fold. Both sides of the ratio are measured in the same pilot, so machine contention largely cancels in it while the realized reference seconds carry the absolute scale
failure_policy: a failed check fails its job; a failed job cancels the pending jobs and no table is written; failures are never omitted; no adaptive stopping on any value
fit: MultiViewArrowFlowKNN at bridge.resolve_selected(sealed config, n_features, n_train) on the outer training rows with the arm's hidden widths and update rule: for view v, OrdinalEncoder(view_strategy, embed_dim, degree, lda_ratio, derive_seed(8129, "view", v)), ArrowFlowEstimator.initialize_orders then train_initialized, then MultiViewArrowFlowKNN._fit_view_readout (select_knn_readout on the trained hidden ranking); majority vote over the seven per-view kNN readouts
fit_seed_statement: The reference design fits three seeds per outer fold; these controlled arms are fitted at seed 8129 alone, because four (depth) and three (aggregation) full seven-view fits per outer fold at three seeds project beyond the approved budget for this follow-up. The arms of one fold therefore share one encoder draw and one initial state, so the comparison is paired within seed; no within-fold seed spread is estimated and every interval is over the fifteen outer folds of that one seed.
instrumentation: instance-level wrappers installed on each view network between initialize_orders and train_initialized and removed afterwards (update_rules.ArmInstrumentation): Vertex.accumulate_motion counts the eligible votes and their mass, Vertex.apply_motion records the movement of the filter and freezes it in a frozen layer, and in a median arm Vertex.compute_adj_list_with_permutation returns the footrule-median order of the same accumulator. The signal generation, the eligibility gate, the initial state, the data, the randomization, the batch resets and the readout protocol are untouched; the wrapper around update_network only closes the per-batch record inside a guard that restores the global numpy and Python RNG states

mass_matching.problem: matching the step size alone is not a fair control: the accumulator carries the prior at weight exactly one while one batch of votes carries a mass of order 0.1, so the footrule median can be frozen at the prior while Borda, being a mean, still moves
mass_matching.reporting: the movement rates of every arm are reported, so a moving-against-inert comparison is never read as evidence about independence of irrelevant alternatives
mass_matching.rule: median keeps the accumulator as the core builds it (prior weight 1, the plain substitution). median_mass_matched gives the prior m times the mean incoming ballot weight (mass / votes), so the incoming-to-prior mass ratio is votes / m to 1
mass_matching.selection: m is the ladder value whose mean per-batch changed-filter share over the hidden layers, on the training-only pilot fits of the pilot datasets, is closest to the borda arm's on the same partitions; ties to the smallest m. No outer-fold score takes part
mass_matching.status: the fairness rule of the aggregation family; fixed before the run and recorded in the frozen protocol

mass_matching_choice.rule: the ladder value whose mean per-batch changed-filter share over the hidden layers on the training-only pilot fits is closest to the borda arm's on the same partitions; ties to the smallest multiplier; no outer-fold score takes part

measures.depth_probe: per arm, view and hidden layer, the representation after that layer (models.transform_orders_by_depth) read out by a footrule kNN at the view's own selected setting refitted on the training rows at that depth, scored on the outer test rows, with its neighbourhood purity and the seven-view majority at each depth; at the last hidden layer the probe must equal the view readout
measures.inertness: an arm is flagged effectively inert on a fold when its changed-filter share over the hidden layers is below 0.01; a contrast against an effectively inert arm is never read as evidence about the aggregation rule
measures.movement: per arm, view and hidden layer, over the training batches: the share of filters that changed and the mean normalised footrule displacement (footrule / floor(V^2 / 2)), with the number of eligible votes, the incoming vote mass and the realised incoming-to-prior mass ratio
measures.neighborhood_purity: per arm, the mean over views of the share of same-class neighbours of the outer test rows in the last hidden ranking: the k nearest training rows under the footrule distance, k the view readout's own n_neighbors
measures.outer_metrics: per arm, the seven-view majority on the outer test rows: accuracy, error, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 (evaluation.metric_values)

median_rule.computation: the footrule median is the linear assignment on C = A D with D[q, p] = |q - p| (scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment), the exact minimiser over all orders
median_rule.objective: the hidden-layer update minimises, over the V! orders of the filter, the weighted sum of rank distances to the prior (weight 1) and to each vote (weight |a_t|); the core uses the squared rank distance, whose minimiser is the accumulator row mean (a weighted Borda count, verified in review-math-actions.md section 2(a)), and the median arm uses the footrule distance
median_rule.scope: hidden layers only; the output layer keeps the core rule, so the checkpoint and the output rule are unchanged
median_rule.ties: the solver's optimum is canonicalised by zero-cost transpositions toward the lexicographically smallest position vector read in ascending item order; what remains is the deterministic choice of the pinned solver among exactly tied optima. On 400 random small accumulators the returned order attained the minimum in every case and equalled the lexicographically smallest minimiser in 393 (66 instances had tied optima); the brute-force test records this

not_retuned: the learning rate, the iteration count, the batch size, the checkpoint ratio, the encoder, the vocabulary, the degree and the augmentation are the fold's own selection and are not re-tuned for any arm; this is a controlled comparison at one configuration and not an estimate of the best attainable model of any arm

outputs.analysis: aggregation_contrasts.csv and aggregation_analysis.json by the analyse stage
outputs.job_records: jobs/<dataset>__r<repeat>f<fold>.json with every measure and check, artifacts/<stem>.npz with the per-arm view, depth and majority predictions and the per-batch movement series, predictions/<stem>.jsonl with the per-example outer predictions of every arm
outputs.overwrite: an existing file with different content is never replaced
outputs.summary: aggregation_summary.json and aggregation_summary.csv by the summary stage
outputs.tables: arms.csv, depth_probe.csv, movement.csv and provenance.json, written only after every planned job succeeded and verified (all or none)

own_arm: the arm whose parameters are the fold's own reconstructed selection (in the depth family depth1 or depth2 according to the selected widths, in the aggregation family always borda); it must reproduce the reference run's outer predictions for seed 8129 exactly
parallelism: one spawned single-thread process per dataset and outer fold under the shared execution lock
pilot: training-only: the first outer fold of each pilot dataset with the outer test rows replaced by every fourth outer training row (the outer test fold is never touched), every arm, measure and check except the reference predictions; one reproduction probe (run_knn_ablation.reproduction_probe) of the smallest dataset per reference; in the aggregation family the mass-matching ladder

pilot_projection.decision_rule: freeze only if the calibrated projection at 16 single-thread workers is at most 4.0 h: the simulated first-free-worker makespan of the planned jobs in planned order, each job priced at the reference run's realized outer fit and predict seconds of its fold and seed 8129 times the piloted job / uninstrumented-fit ratio (its own ratio for a pilot dataset, the largest piloted ratio otherwise), plus the realized seconds once more for the uninstrumented fit of a first fold. Both sides of the ratio are measured in the same pilot, so machine contention largely cancels in it while the realized reference seconds carry the absolute scale

stages.machine: two production runs (dedup and artificial) held 32 workers throughout the smoke and the pilot, so every pilot second is inflated by contention; only the job / uninstrumented-fit ratio carries into the projection, and the cap is set above the projection for that reason

decision.rule: freeze only if the calibrated projection at 16 single-thread workers is at most 4.0 h: the simulated first-free-worker makespan of the planned jobs in planned order, each job priced at the reference run's realized outer fit and predict seconds of its fold and seed 8129 times the piloted job / uninstrumented-fit ratio (its own ratio for a pilot dataset, the largest piloted ratio otherwise), plus the realized seconds once more for the uninstrumented fit of a first fold. Both sides of the ratio are measured in the same pilot, so machine contention largely cancels in it while the realized reference seconds carry the absolute scale

mass_matching.rule: the ladder value whose mean per-batch changed-filter share over the hidden layers on the training-only pilot fits is closest to the borda arm's on the same partitions; ties to the smallest multiplier; no outer-fold score takes part

smoke.note: a synthetic ArrowFlow-kNN reference run at both smoke depths, its component ablation, a complete intervention run, its tables, its summary and its analysis; never evidence

stages.summary: the synthetic smoke passed every check on 3 jobs and 3 arms; the training-only pilot on iris and ionosphere passed every check and its reproduction probes; 46 passed (tests/make_revision/test_update_rules.py and test_interventions.py)

purpose: a controlled aggregation comparison inside ArrowFlow-kNN: the Borda order of the hidden-layer update against the footrule median of the same votes
resource_decision: Review response E4 (aggregation; author decision of 2026-09-14 and the E4 aggregation ruling): the synthetic smoke passed every check on 3 jobs and 3 arms; the training-only pilot on iris and ionosphere passed every check and its reproduction probes; 46 passed (tests/make_revision/test_update_rules.py and test_interventions.py); projected at 16 single-thread workers: calibrated simulated makespan 0.99 h (serial 13.94 h, serial over workers 0.87 h), harness 0.91 h; cap 4.0 h. The pilot ran while two production runs held 32 workers, so its absolute seconds are inflated by contention and only the job / uninstrumented-fit ratio carries forward (ionosphere 3.15, iris 3.41); the rule prices every unpiloted dataset at the largest of those, measured on the smallest training partition, where the per-arm bookkeeping weighs most. The cap is set above the projection for both reasons and no outer score of this family exists. Reproduction probes held on iris, ionosphere, vertebra_column; mass-matching multiplier 4 chosen on the training-only pilot ladder; frozen after the pilot
selection_statement: Nothing is selected on outer-fold results. Every configuration is the per-fold selection sealed by the reference ablation run; every kNN readout setting is the one the fit chose on training rows; the mass-matching multiplier is chosen on the training-only pilot before the run; no outer score feeds back into any fit, arm, dataset, fold or analysis choice.
unit_of_work: every protocol dataset x every outer fold (5 folds x 3 repeats) x fitting seed 8129 x every arm
